locations.name: Bahen 1F
locations.brief_description: You are on the first floor of the Bahen Center. There are elevators to the West, and an exit from the building to St. George street to the East. You see something shiny on the ground -- looks like a toonie?
locations.long_description: You are on the first floor of the Bahen Center. It's usually crowded at this time of the day, but today it's eerily quiet. Only a few students are studying at the table near the doors. You better not disturb them. One student is rushing down the corridor, wearing a heavy-looking backpack and carrying a textbook in their arms. There are elevators to the West, and an exit from the building to St. George street to the East.

items.name: toonie
items.description: There is a toonie on the ground. Someone must have dropped it.

locations.name: the Robarts Library 1F
locations.brief_description: You are on the first floor of the Robarts Library. There are elevators to the West, public computers to the East,the bookshelves to the North, and an exit from the building to Huron Street to the South.
locations.long_description: You are on the first floor of the Robarts Library. Students pass by quietly, some heading toward the elevators while others sit at nearby computers. There are elevators to the West, public computers to the East, bookshelves to the North, and an exit from the building to Huron Street to the South.

locations.name: elevators on 1F
locations.brief_description: You are standing in front of the elevators. You can take the elevator up to the second floor.
locations.long_description: You are standing in front of the elevators. A small sign shows that the current floor is the first floor. You can take the elevator up to the second floor.

locations.name: computer area
locations.brief_description: There are many computers. This is a great place to study.
locations.long_description: There are many computers. Many students are working in focused silence. This would be a great place to study—if you had time.

locations.name: book shelves
locations.brief_description: Tall bookshelves surround you. This can be a great place to read books and learn more about how to improve your project.
locations.long_description: Tall bookshelves surround you. This can be a great place to read books and learn more about how to improve your project, but the deadline is creeping closer.

locations.name: elevators on 2F
locations.brief_description: You are standing in front of the elevators. You can take the elevator down to the first floor.
locations.long_description: You are standing in front of the elevators. A small sign shows that the current floor is the second floor. You can take the elevator down to the first floor.

locations.name: the Robarts Library 2F
locations.brief_description: You are on the second floor of the Robarts Library. There are elevators to the West, a study room to the East, and a cafeteria to the North.
locations.long_description: You are on the second floor of the Robarts Library. This floor feels quieter and more focused. There are elevators to the West, a study room to the East, and a cafeteria to the North.

locations.name: study room
locations.brief_description: You are now in the study room.
locations.long_description: You are now in the study room. It is very quiet. A few students are hunched over notebooks and laptops.

locations.name: cafeteria
locations.brief_description: You are now in the cafeteria.
locations.long_description: You are now in the cafeteria. It smells faintly of coffee. A few abandoned cups sit on the tables. Something familiar catches your eye.

items.name: lucky mug
items.description: Your lucky U of T mug. It has been with you through every late-night study session, every major deadline, and every all-nighter.

locations.name: elevator 2F
locations.brief_description: You are on the second floor of the Bahen Center. There are elevators to the West and a lab room
locations.long_description: You are on the second floor of the Bahen Center. It's usually crowded at this time of the day, but today it's eerily quiet. Only a few students are studying at the table near the doors. You better not disturb them. There is an elevator to the West and a locked Lab Room

name: Lab Room
brief_description: You are now in front of lab room.
long_description: You are now in the Lab room. It is locked. You must use key to enter this room.

name: Lecture Room
brief_description: You are in the lecture room
long_description: You are now in the lecture room. There was a student who seemed to be looking for something.
